name: Gigantler
look: a huge long-legged brown moose with a zigzag flank stripe, cream legs, a lowered head with a stern glare and three massive crown-like palmate antlers
entry: The antlers on its head grow back bigger every year, and an old bull's three crowns can span wider than a cabin. Packs of predators turn back the moment it lowers its head, and travellers in the northern woods take a glimpse of one as a sign of good fortune.
how: Wild: rare in taigas and snowy forests, rarer in swamps and tundra.
